components.name: LandingPage (Home) root
components.purpose: Marketing landing page. Client component; redirects authenticated users to /planner; runs a typing effect and an IntersectionObserver that adds .visible to .animate-on-scroll elements (threshold 0.1, honors prefers-reduced-motion by adding .visible to all immediately).
components.props: none (default export, no props). Uses useSession().status, useGuestStore(s => s.enterGuestMode), useState typedText.
components.notes: Page order: sticky nav -> hero (min-h-screen, clip-hero-bottom) -> #overview (white, py-24) -> #flow (navy, clip-diagonal-both, py-32 md:py-40) -> #features CTA (pale blue gradient, py-24). No <footer> element; the ui/Footer component is NOT used on this page. handleGuestMode() calls enterGuestMode() then window.location.href = '/planner' (hard navigation, not router.push).

oddities: LIKELY VISUAL BUG: hero primary CTA passes className 'bg-white text-[#153974] hover:bg-white/90' to Button, but cn() = twMerge(clsx()). twMerge treats bg-white (bg-color) and the default variant's bg-gradient-to-r from-[#153974] to-[#3069B3] (bg-image / gradient stops) as different groups, so the navy gradient background-image survives and paints over the white background-color. Result would be navy gradient with navy text. Verify in a browser; fix by passing variant='outline'/'ghost' or adding bg-none.

Hex values outside the brand trio #153974 / #3069B3 / #00AACA: #0a1e3d and #1a2f5a (hero gradient stops), #0f2847 (flow gradient start), #f0f7ff and #e8f4fd (CTA background), #003E7E (Button default hover gradient start), #4dd9f0 / #60a5fa (Tailwind blue-400) / #a78bfa (Tailwind violet-400) in .text-gradient-typing - the violet is off-brand. The logo SVG itself uses #0d3f7a and #00b5d1, which are close to but not equal to #153974 / #00AACA.
Two different 'dark navy' gradients: hero uses from-[#0a1e3d] via-[#153974] to-[#1a2f5a] (to-br) while the flow band uses from-[#0f2847] to-[#153974] (to-br). No shared token.

Eyebrow style drifts in the CTA section: 'text-sm uppercase tracking-widest text-[#00AACA] font-medium mb-4' vs the standard 'text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-semibold text-[#00AACA] mb-3' (tracking-widest = 0.1em). It is also the only Korean eyebrow ('지금이 가장 빠릅니다') while the others are English ('SERVICE', 'HOW IT WORKS'); uppercase has no effect on Hangul.
CTA h2 scales to md:text-5xl whereas the other two section h2s use md:text-4xl.

Opacity notation is mixed: bg-[#00AACA]/[0.08] (bracketed decimal) alongside bg-[#3069B3]/10, bg-[#00AACA]/5, bg-[#00AACA]/30, and a wrapper using opacity-[0.08]. Also rotate-[-3deg] / right-[-5%] / bottom-[-5%] instead of -rotate-3 / -right-[5%].
Two <h1> elements on the page: the nav wordmark 'YU 수강 플래너' and the hero title. The nav one should be a div/span or the hero should be the sole h1.
Primary CTAs are a <Link href='/login'> wrapping a <Button> (anchor containing a button) - nested interactive elements; the inner button has no type and no onClick.

Contrast concerns: text-white/40 on #153974 (hero footnote) is roughly 3:1 - below AA for 14px text; text-gray-400 (#9ca3af) on the #e8f4fd CTA background is roughly 2.3:1; text-white/60 body copy on navy is around 5:1 (passes). The text-gradient-typing headline relies on a drop-shadow for legibility.

The ghost CTA in #features has no explicit text color (inherits body color) and hovers to bg-gray-100 on a pale blue gradient; the hero ghost explicitly sets text-white/70 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/10. Ghost variant has no default text color token.

Button focus ring: focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 with no ring color class, so it falls back to Tailwind v4's default (currentColor) - on the white hero button that would be navy, on the gradient button white-ish; not a consistent brand focus style.

Mobile flow steps override .deco-number's clamp(80px,15vw,160px) with inline style={{ fontSize: '56px' }} - the only inline style besides the logo's width:auto. Desktop/mobile step markup is fully duplicated rather than responsive.

Stagger timings are inconsistent: feature rows and mobile steps use 0/100/200(/300)ms, desktop steps use 0/150/300ms; hero CTA row and hero footnote share anim-delay-300 so they appear simultaneously.

Section id 'features' holds the final CTA, not a feature list (features live under #overview); the nav labels it '시작하기'. Section anchors use scroll-mt-20 (80px) as an approximation of the nav height (py-4 + 24px logo + border).
Mobile nav drops the section links (hidden md:flex) with no hamburger/menu fallback.

.glass sets its own 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.3) border, then the nav adds border-b border-gray-200/50 - border-gray-200/50 recolors all four sides, so which color wins depends on cascade order between the custom class and utilities.
Hero typed line is whitespace-nowrap at text-4xl (36px) on phones; '직관적으로 관리하다.' (11 glyphs) is ~400px wide and may overflow or clip on 320-360px viewports (section is overflow-hidden).

Hero mosaic reuses help-doc screenshots (/help/*.png) with alt='' and hard-coded width/height props (800x400 etc.) that are unlikely to match the real PNG aspect ratios; at opacity 0.08 + blur-[1px] this is purely textural.

.bg-grid draws black 3%-alpha lines and is then set to opacity-5 on a navy background - effectively invisible (0.15% alpha). Similarly .deco-number stroke rgba(21,57,116,0.08) on white and deco-number-light rgba(255,255,255,0.06) on navy are extremely faint by design.
Reduced motion: scroll reveals and CSS keyframes are disabled under prefers-reduced-motion (JS + CSS), but the JS typing effect keeps mutating the headline text every 50-100ms.

Brand voice: body copy is 해요체 polite imperative ('-세요') with occasional 합니다체 ('됩니다', '않습니다', '빠릅니다'); hero taglines use the literary '-하다.' infinitive with a trailing period; headings carry no punctuation except one question mark; lead paragraphs inconsistently end with or without a period; zero emoji anywhere; English used only for the slogan 'YU the Future' and section eyebrows; the phrase '한눈에' recurs four times as a brand motif.
No <footer> on the landing page - the ui/Footer component exists (src/components/ui/Footer.tsx) but is not rendered here; the page ends with the #features CTA section.

Legacy v3 gradient utilities (bg-gradient-to-br / bg-gradient-to-b / bg-gradient-to-r) are used throughout rather than Tailwind v4's bg-linear-to-* names (still supported, but a naming inconsistency to be aware of in a new design system).
